evidence.detail: rs/A/f implements the Gson JsonSerializer<Color> and JsonDeserializer<Color> contracts directly for java.awt.Color.

Serialization writes a JSON object containing the exact key value from Color.getRGB(), plus falpha=0.0; deserialization requires an object with value and reconstructs java.awt.Color from that integer.
The client Guice/Gson module rs/p/b constructs rs/A/f and registers it as the type adapter for java.awt.Color before creating the shared Gson instance.
That shared Gson instance is bound by the module and consumed by the configuration/plugin infrastructure, so this adapter is live runtime configuration serialization rather than an isolated helper.

candidates.note: ColorGsonAdapter is the conservative semantic name for this exact java.awt.Color Gson serializer/deserializer. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.

evidence.detail: rs/A/o is entirely built around com.apple.eawt Application and FullScreenUtilities APIs and first gates fullscreen setup on the client's macOS platform enum.
Its JFrame helper installs R21 OSXFullScreenAdapter, enables native fullscreen, and preserves the exact diagnostic "Enabled fullscreen on macOS".

The two no-arg helpers call Application.requestUserAttention(true) and Application.requestForeground(true), preserving the exact diagnostics "Requested user attention on macOS" and "Forced focus on macOS".
The live UI shell rs/ui/f calls the attention/focus helpers for notification focus behavior, while the GUI frame path calls the fullscreen/focus helper; this is active platform-window plumbing.

candidates.note: MacOSWindowUtil is the conservative semantic name for this exact macOS fullscreen, focus and user-attention helper. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
